name: Britannia Industries Ltd
title: Britannia Industries Ltd - 500825 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 consol sales +7.1% to INR 4,686 cr with PAT +21% helped by tax case releases; domestic growth ~9-9.5% ex dual-pricing and West Asia, with price hikes and no capacity-discipline signal.

triggers.label: Calibrated price increases from Q1 FY27
triggers.quote: So, there will be calibrated price increases starting from this quarter.

triggers.label: Dual pricing in INR 5/10 hurting wholesale
triggers.quote: because of some dual pricing existing. So as a result of that, we have seen some kind of a transaction slowdown in those channels.

triggers.label: Q4 volume growth ~5.5%
triggers.quote: So we had a volume growth of close to 5.5% upwards.

triggers.label: Mundra shift for North America
triggers.quote: we had moved all the manufacturing for North America to Oman. But we have been able to move all that manufacturing gradually back to Mundra

guidance.quote: we are quite confident that by the end of the quarter, the market would quite likely stabilize on the domestic front

red_flags.label: PAT inflated by tax case release
red_flags.quote: Obviously, this 21.1% growth also comes as we have observed in the comments, because of some income tax case closures.

red_flags.label: Other expenses +18% on sales +7%
red_flags.quote: The other expenses growth of 18% on a top line growth of only 7%

evasions.quote: Now it is hypothetical for us to say whether it's impacted by 200 or 300 or 400 basis points.
But obviously, we have to execute that as the year goes on.
